name: Morozov-SH-I Helmet Gideon
description: Featuring the same fortified armor plating, special anti-rip protective padding and ample storage, as the Morozov SH, the SH-I industrial variant was designed by RRS to protect workers employed in hostile zones while ensuring they had the full range of motion required to perform their duties. The Gideon edition features a heavily worn teal finish with yellow accents. Visor is AR crosshair compatible.
